title: Free-plan ceilings: Browser Rendering's burst rate is the one that bites; Pages 500 builds/month; Actions unlimited only while the repo is public
body:
- Cloudflare Pages: 500 builds/month, unlimited bandwidth/requests. Every extra preview branch spends builds.
- Browser Rendering: 10 browser minutes/day, 3 concurrent browsers, one new instance every 20 s; a render takes 3-5 s. The RATE is what gets hit: on 2026-09-04, a day of deploys, production /cv.pdf answered 429 and the visitor got `pdfQuotaExceeded`. That is why the edge caches a PDF for 30 DAYS keyed by deployed commit (functions/_pdf.ts; README's '1 h edge cache' is outdated — 1 h is the browser max-age), why smoke-deploy.yml and `pdf:refresh` warm the two locales sequentially, never in parallel, and why the Function propagates 429 + Retry-After instead of a broken PDF. A develop->staging->main chain is two deploys = four cold renders.
- GitHub Actions: no minute cap because the repo is public (private repos get 2,000/month). Making the repo private would cap CI and also lose rulesets on the Free plan.
- Microsoft Clarity and Cloudflare Web Analytics: free, no cap.
Anything that adds renders per deploy or per visit must be weighed against the Browser Rendering rate.
not_derivable: Plan limits and the 2026-09-04 incident are external facts; README's table is partly stale (1 h edge cache).
